card.name: Words leading into dietary intake limits
card.fires_on: Small linking words or spaces just before a recommended intake or upper-limit phrase, in vitamin and mineral nutrition text (e.g. 'suggests an', 'exceeded the', 'Institute of Medicine's').

modes.label: Before upper limit
modes.description: Article or space right before a tolerable upper limit figure for a vitamin or mineral.
